args.title: SRC-CRE-007 RFQ to Auction Template Switch

steps.note: Provide the required event title for a create test.
Verify that the RFQ stage has a template applied before switching event type.
Add a product so its retention can be checked after switching to Auction.
Confirm the RFQ product row exists before the event type change.
